Every copied A Markdown, including embedded historical documents, needs an
explicit original-document path and consumed accepted origin reference.
Explicit historical Round0 targets remain historical. External file targets
need exact pin/version resolution; directory targets need a complete bound
ordinary-file scope. Navigation targets must use root's already preserved
matching control originals. No new control copy or index edit occurs here.

The inline-link recognizer is a scoped adaptation of the accepted recorder,
not a complete CommonMark engine. It adds inline image targets, compares the

syntax it does not support. Ambiguous or unsupported syntax requires a
separate disclosed correction, not silent omission or rewriting a copied
document. Root must inspect the actual final documents before binding.

in root's actual external invocation record; after admission a FAILURE record
and partial keys are added exclusively in that attempt.

Source preparation checks are syntax/AST/schema-metadata/whitelist checks

    """Scan explicit inline-link delimiters, independently of producer regex."""
    i = 0
    while i < len(text):
        if text[i] != '[' or (i > 0 and text[i - 1] in '!\\'):
            i += 1
            continue
        j = text.find(']', i + 1)
        if j < 0 or '\n' in text[i:j] or text[j + 1:j + 2] != '(':
            i += 1
            continue
        k = j + 2
        depth = 1
        while k < len(text) and depth and text[k] != '\n':
            if text[k] == '\\':
                k += 2
                continue
            if text[k] == '(':
                depth += 1
            elif text[k] == ')':
                depth -= 1
            k += 1
        need(depth == 0, ('balanced explicit Markdown target', i))
        yield text[j + 2:k - 1].strip().removeprefix('<').removesuffix('>')
        i = k
